Bundled third-party renderer: Proton
====================================

File:      app_pojavlauncher/src/main/jniLibs/armeabi-v7a/libpowervr.so
Renderer:  Proton ("PowerVR Unified"), a desktop OpenGL over OpenGL ES translator
Upstream:  https://github.com/kushaladhikari982648-lgtm/proton-renderer
Built by:  the upstream project's GitHub Actions (the library records its build path
           /home/runner/work/proton-renderer/proton-renderer/... and reports itself as
           "Krypton Wrapper with glslang and SPIRV-Cross")
Sources:   the library is a merge of two upstream projects,
             - Large Thin Wrapper (LTW), https://github.com/MojoLauncher/LTW
             - NG-GL4ES ("Krypton Wrapper"), https://github.com/BZLZHH/NG-GL4ES
           See those repositories for the corresponding source and their licence terms.

Packaged ABI: 32-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a) only.

This is the library shipped in the PowerVR Unified r2 plugin APK
(np.proton.renderer.powervr, version 0.2.0-experimental) published by the upstream project,
for its 32-bit ARM build. It is bundled so the renderer is available without installing a
separate plugin APK; the plugin APK is still detected and usable if it is installed.

The renderer is offered on 32-bit devices only, which is what the app reports next to its
name, because that is the only ABI of it that is packaged here. It needs nothing but the
system EGL implementation and its own library; it is aimed at PowerVR GPUs, where the
platform GLES driver is the weakest link.
